description: Hiring and applicant workflow — recruitment pipeline management

key_fields.partner_name: Char — candidate display name, primary identifier
key_fields.stage_id: Many2one hr.recruitment.stage — computed, domain scoped to job, group_expand
key_fields.kanban_state: Selection normal/done/waiting/blocked, reset on stage change
key_fields.pool_applicant_id: Many2one self — canonical talent record link (Odoo 19 new)

key_methods.create_employee_from_applicant: Creates hr.employee from accepted applicant; copies attachments; populates job/dept/email/phone
key_methods.reset_applicant: Reinserts into first pipeline stage, clears refuse_reason_id
key_methods.action_create_meeting: Opens calendar.event form pre-linked to applicant
key_methods.message_new: Email gateway handler — parses sender, detects job platforms, sets initial stage
key_methods._read_group_stage_ids: Kanban group expansion — shows global + job-specific stages

key_fields.name: Char required, translate
key_fields.job_ids: Many2many hr.job — empty = global stage, set = job-specific stage
key_fields.hired_stage: Boolean — triggers date_closed auto-set and no_of_recruitment decrement
key_fields.template_id: Many2one mail.template — auto-email on stage entry
key_fields.fold: Boolean — folded in kanban when empty
key_fields.rotting_threshold_days: Integer — days before applicant becomes stale (0=disabled)
key_fields.legend_done: Char — kanban Ready for Next Stage label

hr.recruitment.stage.stage_scoping: Stages with job_ids=False are global; stages with job_ids set appear only for those jobs. _read_group_stage_ids enforces this in kanban.

hr.job.description: Job position — extended by hr_recruitment module

base_module_fields.no_of_recruitment: Integer 'Target' — expected new hires, must be >= 0
base_module_fields.no_of_employee: Computed — current employee count in this job

recruitment_added_fields.no_of_hired_employee: Computed stored — count of applicants with date_closed set
recruitment_added_fields.open_application_count: Computed — applications not in hired stage
recruitment_added_fields.alias_id: mail.alias.mixin — job email alias for application intake

hr.job.note_odoo19: The legacy state field ('open'/'recruit') is NOT present in Odoo 19 Community. Job openness is inferred from no_of_recruitment target and application counts.

fields.name: Char required, translate
fields.template_id: Many2one mail.template domain model=hr.applicant — refusal email template

hr.talent.pool.description: Named candidate pools for future hiring (NEW Odoo 19)

hr.job.platform.description: Known job board email addresses with regex patterns for applicant name extraction
hr.job.platform.used_in: hr.applicant.message_new() — detects platform emails and extracts candidate name from subject

calendar.event.added_field: applicant_id = Many2one('hr.applicant', ondelete='set null', btree_not_null index)
calendar.event.behaviour: Default_get routes to applicant context. Attachments copied from applicant when creating meeting. is_highlighted computed when viewing calendar from applicant.

groups.name: Interviewer
groups.access: Read own assigned applicants only (job_id.interviewer_ids or applicant.interviewer_ids). No create/unlink. Can refuse applicants and schedule meetings.

groups.name: Officer: Manage all applicants
groups.access: Full CRUD on all applicants. Implies Interviewer.

groups.name: Administrator
groups.access: All Officer rights plus manage activity plans for applicants. Admin and root users included by default.

notable_rules: Interviewer ir.rule: domain filters to jobs/applicants where user is in interviewer_ids
Multi-company rule: applicants scoped to user's allowed companies

wizards.description: Refuse applicant(s) with optional email notification. Supports bulk duplicate refusal.
wizards.key_action: action_refuse_reason_apply() — sets refuse_reason_id, active=False, refuse_date on all applicant_ids (and optionally duplicate_applicant_ids)

wizards.description: Add one or more applicants to a talent pool
Create applications from talent pool entries for a specific job

migration_flags: BREAKING: hr.job.state field (open/recruit) removed in Odoo 19
BREAKING: Employee creation method renamed to create_employee_from_applicant()
INFORMATIONAL: No payroll/analytic integration in Community edition
